text:
Maya_CS: Heads-up — PolarisRX onboarding: their APAC demo traffic tomorrow morning is concentrated in Tokyo and we're seeing 5xx throttles from edge rate limits. They asked for a temporary config change for a 3h window. Can ops handle an ephemeral pin + allowlist? :handshake:
Jon_CSM: This is part of their renewal play. If demo latency drops it's a big win. Please include a short note for the AE and I'll join the demo.
Ravi_Ops: I can apply. Proposal: pin demo traffic to ap-northeast-1, add two demo IPs to ephemeral allowlist, raise burst to 900 rps for 3h, and set a 4h autorevoke TTL. Also add header-based match so only demo flows are affected. Fallback to eu-west-1 at 180ms p50.
Maya_CS: Demo client originates from 203.0.113.45 and 203.0.113.46. They set header `X-PRX-Demo: demo` on demo calls.
Nina_Engineer: Routing-by-header supported but we'll need a config rule. I can push the rule to staging and run a quick smoke. ETA 25m.
Kai_SRE: Recommend pre-warm KV cache 12 minutes before demo with synthetic warmup to avoid tokenization cost spikes. I'll watch p95 during warmup and abort if regression >12%.
Ravi_Ops: I'll schedule pre-warm at T-12m and apply config at demo start. Plan ephemeral allowlist TTL=4h so it auto-revokes.
Maya_CS: Paste the exact snippet you plan to apply so I can include in the enablement note.
Ravi_Ops: Pasting planned config (will apply at 07:00 JST / 22:00 UTC tonight):

```
customer: "polarisrx"
change_id: "3332101234-ephemeral"
allowlist_ips: ["203.0.113.45/32","203.0.113.46/32"]
rate_limit: {region: "ap-northeast-1", burst_rps: "900", window_start: "2024-10-02T22:00:00Z", window_end: "2024-10-03T01:00:00Z", autorevoke_ttl: "4h"}
routing: {match_header: {name: "X-PRX-Demo", value: "demo"}, primary_region: "ap-northeast-1", fallback: "eu-west-1", fallback_latency_ms: "180"}
```

Nina_Engineer: Config looks fine. I'll validate on staging and post smoke logs here (latency, error rate, token cost).
Kai_SRE: I'll trigger pre-warm and set alerting for token cost and p95. If p95 increases by >12% we rollback and notify.
Jon_CSM: I've updated renewal tracker: "PolarisRX demo w/ ephemeral regional pin and rlift; success reduces uplifts risk." Also scheduled a 10m AE prep call 20m before start.
deploy-bot: change_request polarisrx-3332101234 queued for manual approval by Ravi_Ops at 2024-10-02T21:40:00Z
Ravi_Ops: Approved. Pre-warm scheduled 21:48 UTC, apply at 22:00 UTC. I'll post smoke results + revoke time here after window ends.
Maya_CS: Great — please @channel any major regressions. I'll collect demo feedback from PolarisRX PM and drop notes back into renewal tracker and this thread.
